'''The Promenade''' was a [[Hotel/Legends|hotel]] located in the town of [[Corestrike]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Chrona/Legends|Chrona]]. It was a ramshackle building made of gray pressure-formed blocks. Staying at The Promenade was cheaper than staying at either the [[Corestrike Hotel]] or [[The Rising Moon]].<ref name="HNNA" />
